newsitem.title: USA: Conneticut housing permits rise 5.8 pct in Sept - paper.
newsitem.headline: Conneticut housing permits rise 5.8 pct in Sept - paper.

text.p: Connecticut's communities issued 717 housing permits in September, a 5.8 rise from a year ago, but in the first nine months of 1996 the total has dropped 11.2 percent, Hartford Courant reported Thursday.
Donald Klepper-Smith, president of DataCore Partners, was quoted as saying that the lack of new housing construction was one of the few negatives seen in the state economy.
Six counties in the state saw mostly modest gains in September when compared with the year-ago period.
Fairfield and Windham counties saw decreases in the number of permits, according to the paper.
